title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG, PASSEPARTOUT, AND FIX GO EACH ABOUT HIS BUSINESS
summary_hover: A storm delays the Rangoon's arrival in Hong Kong, but Fogg fortuitously catches a delayed steamer and decides to take Aouda to Europe.
summary_detail: A severe storm delays the steamer Rangoon, causing it to arrive in Hong Kong twenty-four hours late. Fogg discovers the Yokohama steamer, the 'Carnatic', was also delayed for boiler repairs, saving his schedule. Upon finding that Aouda's cousin Jeejeeh has moved to Europe, Fogg calmly offers to take Aouda with him to Europe, instructing Passepartout to book three cabins on the 'Carnatic'.
